Home.sectionSubtitle: A quick, practical path to get on the air legally in Portugal.
Home.processHeading: Ham Radio in Portugal: Due Process

study.title: 1) Study & Practice
study.description: Cover the syllabus for Category 3, 2 or 1. Use browse and simulation exams here.

exam.title: 2) Take the Exam
exam.description: Register with ANACOM and pass the exam to obtain the aptitude certificate.

license.title: 3) License & Callsign
license.description: Apply for your amateur radio license and callsign with ANACOM and pay the applicable fees.

operate.title: 4) Operate Responsibly
operate.description: Follow your category privileges and comply with national and CEPT regulations.

Home.tipText: Tip: Check official forms on ANACOM and consider a local club for mentoring.
